app.notes: Host Setup: the chain node starts on a public Gonka node that answers your server, waits until it really answers (showing each step) and switches node by itself if one stalls; GNOT connects to your server again by itself if the connection drops; when something fails you get a clear card with Try again and Copy the details. The wallet step no longer uses the faucet: it says how to get GNK and watches the wallet live. An SSH key can be made on the first step, ready for your provider's form, and the review step's files can be changed. Monitor/Vote: the network's total weight and what users paid for AI, epoch by epoch; the section tabs sit in the middle.
